verdict.rationale: Lever is a SaaS applicant-tracking platform, so an official MCP server is a reasonable thing to ask about and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or an agent connector. The REST API, OAuth and webhooks are developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
